baseline.description: Status quo: refit the context on every predict, round-robin, whole-context attention, FIFO, no idempotency keys, erasure deletes the stored dataset only

fifo_no_quota.description: The plane, but one FIFO queue per GPU and no tenant quotas

fixed_chunks.description: The plane, but whole-context attention with no memory model

llm_style.description: What an LLM serving stack would do: keep KV caches with LRU, send work to the least-loaded GPU, fixed chunks, FIFO

lru_no_host.description: The plane, but LRU eviction and no host-RAM tier

no_batching.description: The plane, but each request runs on its own

no_cache_routing.description: The plane, but work goes to the least-loaded GPU whatever caches it holds

no_learning.description: The plane, but the memory and time models stay at the benchmark prior

platform.description: This plane: cache-aware routing with single-flight fits, memory-predicted chunking learned from telemetry, same-context batching, value-based eviction with a host-RAM tier, fair queues and quotas, idempotent ledger, verified erasure
